items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: We were very friends with George Gaynor... And we learned a lot from him.

ctx.x: Have you known many musicians here? Yes.

I also had the opportunity to play with a few of them. So Punch Millers Band, Billy & Dee Dee, and Kit Howard's Band, and Sweet Emmas Band. And we were very friends with George Gaynor, the Band-Jus-Spieler. We were looking for him right now, as we came here, to take him to take a degree. My wife wanted to take a degree. And his knowledge was done. And that went well. He was very good. He was very happy, that he had from far away a lot of students. There were many of him already, from England and Germany. And he…
Have you heard Marvin Kimberl in Old Absent House?
